# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

Solves the AC-OPF problem to find least-cost, AC-feasible operating point

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import sys

        self.gen_status = gen_data[:, 7].astype(int)

        self.pmin = gen_data[:, 9] / self.baseMVA
        self.qmax = gen_data[:, 3] / self.baseMVA
        self.qmin = gen_data[:, 4] / self.baseMVA
        self.vg = gen_data[:, 5]
        self.ngen = len(self.gen_bus)

        # Parse generator costs
        gencost_data = np.array(self.data['gencost'])
        self.cost_model = gencost_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.ncost = gencost_data[:, 3].astype(int)

        # Extract quadratic cost coefficients (c2, c1, c0)
        self.cost_c2 = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        self.cost_c1 = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        self.cost_c0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        for i in range(self.ngen):
            if self.cost_model[i] == 2:  # Polynomial
                n = int(self.ncost[i])
                coeffs = gencost_data[i, 4:4+n]
                if n >= 3:
                    self.cost_c2[i] = coeffs[0] * self.baseMVA**2  # Convert to $/h per pu^2
                    self.cost_c1[i] = coeffs[1] * self.baseMVA
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[2]
                elif n == 2:
                    self.cost_c1[i] = coeffs[0] * self.baseMVA
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[1]
                elif n == 1:
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[0]

        # Create generator-to-bus mapping
        self.gen_at_bus = [[] for _ in range(self.nbus)]
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bus_idx = self.bus_idx[self.gen_bus[g]]
                self.gen_at_bus[bus_idx].append(g)

        # Parse branches
        branch_data = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.f_bus = branch_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.t_bus = branch_data[:, 1].astype(int)
        self.br_r = branch_data[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branch_data[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branch_data[:, 4]
        self.rate_a = branch_data[:, 5] / self.baseMVA
        self.tap = branch_data[:, 8]
        self.shift = branch_data[:, 9] * np.pi / 180
        self.br_status = branch_data[:, 10].astype(int)
        self.angmin = branch_data[:, 11] * np.pi / 180
        self.angmax = branch_data[:, 12] * np.pi / 180
        self.nbranch = len(self.f_bus)

        # Set default tap ratio to 1 if 0
        self.tap[self.tap == 0] = 1.0

        # Build admittance matrix
        self.build_ybus()

        # Find reference bus
        self.ref_bus = np.where(self.bus_type == 3)[0]
        if len(self.ref_bus) == 0:
            print("Warning: No reference bus found, using bus 0")
            self.ref_bus = [0]
        self.ref_bus = self.ref_bus[0]

    def build_ybus(self):
        """Build bus admittance matrix"""
        self.Ybus = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if self.br_status[k] == 0:
                continue

            i = self.bus_idx[self.f_bus[k]]
            j = self.bus_idx[self.t_bus[k]]

            # Series admittance
            y_series = 1 / (self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k])

            # Shunt admittance

            # Transformer ratio
            tap = self.tap[k] * np.exp(1j * self.shift[k])

            # Build Ybus
            self.Ybus[i, i] += (y_series + y_shunt) / (tap * np.conj(tap))
            self.Ybus[j, j] += y_series + y_shunt
            self.Ybus[i, j] += -y_series / np.conj(tap)
            self.Ybus[j, i] += -y_series / tap

        # Add shunt admittances
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            self.Ybus[i, i] += self.gs[i] + 1j * self.bs[i]

    def unpack_x(self, x):

        # x = [va[1:nbus], vm[1:nbus], pg[0:ngen], qg[0:ngen]]
        idx = 0

        va = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        va[0] = 0  # Reference angle
        va[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        vm = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        vm[0] = self.vm_init[self.ref_bus]
        vm[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        pg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]
        idx += self.ngen

        qg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]

        return va, vm, pg, qg

    def pack_x(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Pack optimization variables"""
        return np.concatenate([va[1:], vm[1:], pg, qg])

    def objective(self, x):
        """Objective function: total generation cost"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)

        # Convert pg from pu to MW for cost calculation
        pg_mw = pg * self.baseMVA

        cost = 0
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                cost += self.cost_c2[g] * pg_mw[g]**2 + self.cost_c1[g] * pg_mw[g] + self.cost_c0[g]

        return cost

    def power_balance_residuals(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Calculate power balance residuals at each bus"""
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)

        # Calculate injected power
        S_calc = V * np.conj(self.Ybus @ V)

        # Calculate net injection
        p_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for i in range(self.nbus):
            # Generation at bus
            p_gen = sum(pg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])
            q_gen = sum(qg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])

            # Net injection = generation - load
            p_net[i] = p_gen - self.pd[i]
            q_net[i] = q_gen - self.qd[i]

        # Power balance residuals
        p_residual = p_net - S_calc.real
        q_residual = q_net - S_calc.imag

        return p_residual, q_residual

    def constraints_eq(self, x):
        """Equality constraints: power balance"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(va, vm, pg, qg)

        # Stack all equality constraints
        return np.concatenate([p_residual, q_residual])

    def solve(self):
        """Solve AC-OPF using sequential quadratic programming"""
        print("Setting up AC-OPF problem...")
        print(f"Network: {self.nbus} buses, {self.ngen} generators, {self.nbranch} branches")

        # Initial point
        va0 = self.va_init.copy()
        va0[self.ref_bus] = 0

        vm0 = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Initialize pg at midpoint
        pg0 = (self.pmin + self.pmax) / 2
        pg0[self.gen_status == 0] = 0

        # Initialize qg at zero
        qg0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        x0 = self.pack_x(va0, vm0, pg0, qg0)

        # Variable bounds
        bounds = []

        # Voltage angle bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

        # Voltage magnitude bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i]))

        # Active power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Reactive power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.qmin[g], self.qmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Equality constraints
        constraints = [
            {'type': 'eq', 'fun': self.constraints_eq}
        ]

        print("Solving AC-OPF...")

        # Solve using SLSQP
        result = minimize(
            self.objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={
                'ftol': 1e-6,
                'maxiter': 1000,
                'disp': True
            }
        )

        print(f"\nOptimization status: {result.message}")
        print(f"Success: {result.success}")
        print(f"Iterations: {result.nit}")
        print(f"Objective value: ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")

        # Extract solution
        va_opt, vm_opt, pg_opt, qg_opt = self.unpack_x(result.x)

        # Store solution
        self.va_opt = va_opt
        self.vm_opt = vm_opt
        self.pg_opt = pg_opt
        self.qg_opt = qg_opt
        self.solver_status = "optimal" if result.success else "failed"
        self.total_cost = result.fun

        return result.success

    def calculate_branch_flows(self):
        """Calculate branch power flows"""
        V = self.vm_opt * np.exp(1j * self.va_opt)

        branch_flows = []

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if self.br_status[k] == 0:
                continue

            i = self.bus_idx[self.f_bus[k]]
            j = self.bus_idx[self.t_bus[k]]

            # Series admittance
            y_series = 1 / (self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k])
            y_shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Transformer ratio
            tap = self.tap[k] * np.exp(1j * self.shift[k])

            # Power flow from i to j
            S_ij = V[i] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[i] / tap - y_series * V[j]) / np.conj(tap)

            # Power flow from j to i
            S_ji = V[j] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[j] - y_series * V[i] / tap)

            # MVA flows
            mva_ij = abs(S_ij) * self.baseMVA
            mva_ji = abs(S_ji) * self.baseMVA

            # Loading percentage
            limit_mva = self.rate_a[k] * self.baseMVA
            if limit_mva > 0:
                loading_pct = max(mva_ij, mva_ji) / limit_mva * 100
            else:
                loading_pct = 0

            branch_flows.append({
                'from_bus': int(self.f_bus[k]),
                'to_bus': int(self.t_bus[k]),
                'loading_pct': loading_pct,
                'flow_from_MVA': mva_ij,
                'flow_to_MVA': mva_ji,
                'limit_MVA': limit_mva
            })

        # Sort by loading and return top ones
        branch_flows.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)

        return branch_flows

    def generate_report(self, output_file='report.json'):
        """Generate report in required JSON format"""
        print("\nGenerating report...")

        # Calculate totals
        total_load_MW = np.sum(self.pd) * self.baseMVA
        total_load_MVAr = np.sum(self.qd) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MW = np.sum(self.pg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MVAr = np.sum(self.qg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

        # Check feasibility
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(
            self.va_opt, self.vm_opt, self.pg_opt, self.qg_opt
        )

        max_p_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(p_residual)) * self.baseMVA
        max_q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(q_residual)) * self.baseMVA

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(self.vmin - self.vm_opt, 0) + np.maximum(self.vm_opt - self.vmax, 0)
        max_v_violation = np.max(v_violations)

        # Branch flows
        branch_flows = self.calculate_branch_flows()

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = 0
        for bf in branch_flows:
            if bf['limit_MVA'] > 0:
                overload = max(bf['flow_from_MVA'], bf['flow_to_MVA']) - bf['limit_MVA']
                max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

        # Build report
        report = {
            'summary': {
                'total_cost_per_hour': round(self.total_cost, 2),
                'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
                'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
                'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),
                'total_generation_MVAr': round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
                'total_losses_MW': round(total_losses_MW, 2),
                'solver_status': self.solver_status
            },
            'generators': [],
            'buses': [],
            'most_loaded_branches': branch_flows[:10],  # Top 10
            'feasibility_check': {
                'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_v_violation, 6),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_overload, 2)
            }
        }

        # Add generator data
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            report['generators'].append({
                'id': g + 1,
                'bus': int(self.gen_bus[g]),
                'pg_MW': round(self.pg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(self.qg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(self.pmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmax_MW': round(self.pmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(self.qmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(self.qmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2)
            })

        # Add bus data
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            report['buses'].append({
                'id': int(self.bus_id[i]),
                'vm_pu': round(self.vm_opt[i], 4),
                'va_deg': round(self.va_opt[i] * 180 / np.pi, 2),
                'vmin_pu': round(self.vmin[i], 2),
                'vmax_pu': round(self.vmax[i], 2)
            })

        # Round branch flow values
        for bf in report['most_loaded_branches']:
            bf['loading_pct'] = round(bf['loading_pct'], 2)
            bf['flow_from_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_from_MVA'], 2)
            bf['flow_to_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_to_MVA'], 2)
            bf['limit_MVA'] = round(bf['limit_MVA'], 2)

        # Write report
        with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

        print(f"Report written to {output_file}")

        # Print summary
        print("\n" + "="*60)
        print("AC-OPF SOLUTION SUMMARY")
        print("="*60)
        print(f"Total Cost:           ${self.total_cost:,.2f}/hour")
        print(f"Total Generation:     {total_gen_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Load:           {total_load_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Losses:         {total_losses_MW:,.2f} MW ({total_losses_MW/total_gen_MW*100:.2f}%)")
        print(f"Reactive Generation:  {total_gen_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print(f"Reactive Load:        {total_load_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print("\nFeasibility Check:")
        print(f"  Max P mismatch:     {max_p_mismatch:.6f} MW")
        print(f"  Max Q mismatch:     {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
        print(f"  Max V violation:    {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
        print(f"  Max overload:       {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
        print("\nMost Loaded Branches:")
        for i, bf in enumerate(branch_flows[:5], 1):
            print(f"  {i}. Bus {bf['from_bus']:3d} -> {bf['to_bus']:3d}: {bf['loading_pct']:5.1f}% ({bf['flow_from_MVA']:.1f} MVA)")
        print("="*60)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Solve AC-OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')

    success = solver.solve()

    if success:
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')
    else:
        print("\nWarning: Solver did not converge to optimal solution")
        print("Generating report with best available solution...")
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')

        # x = [va[1:nbus], vm[1:nbus], pg[0:ngen], qg[0:ngen]]
        idx = 0

        va = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        va[0] = 0  # Reference angle
        va[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        vm = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        vm[0] = self.vm_init[self.ref_bus]
        vm[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        pg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]
        idx += self.ngen

        qg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]

        return va, vm, pg, qg

    def pack_x(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Pack optimization variables"""
        return np.concatenate([va[1:], vm[1:], pg, qg])

    def objective(self, x):
        """Objective function: total generation cost"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)

        # Convert pg from pu to MW for cost calculation
        pg_mw = pg * self.baseMVA

        cost = 0
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                cost += self.cost_c2[g] * pg_mw[g]**2 + self.cost_c1[g] * pg_mw[g] + self.cost_c0[g]

        return cost

    def power_balance_residuals(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Calculate power balance residuals at each bus"""
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)

        # Calculate injected power
        S_calc = V * np.conj(self.Ybus @ V)

        # Calculate net injection
        p_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for i in range(self.nbus):
            # Generation at bus
            p_gen = sum(pg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])
            q_gen = sum(qg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])

            # Net injection = generation - load
            p_net[i] = p_gen - self.pd[i]
            q_net[i] = q_gen - self.qd[i]

        # Power balance residuals
        p_residual = p_net - S_calc.real
        q_residual = q_net - S_calc.imag

        return p_residual, q_residual

    def constraints_eq(self, x):
        """Equality constraints: power balance"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(va, vm, pg, qg)

        # Stack all equality constraints
        return np.concatenate([p_residual, q_residual])

    def solve(self):
        """Solve AC-OPF using sequential quadratic programming"""
        print("Setting up AC-OPF problem...")
        print(f"Network: {self.nbus} buses, {self.ngen} generators, {self.nbranch} branches")

        # Initial point
        va0 = self.va_init.copy()
        va0[self.ref_bus] = 0

        vm0 = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Initialize pg at midpoint
        pg0 = (self.pmin + self.pmax) / 2
        pg0[self.gen_status == 0] = 0

        # Initialize qg at zero
        qg0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        x0 = self.pack_x(va0, vm0, pg0, qg0)

        # Variable bounds
        bounds = []

        # Voltage angle bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

        # Voltage magnitude bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i]))

        # Active power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Reactive power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.qmin[g], self.qmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Equality constraints
        constraints = [
            {'type': 'eq', 'fun': self.constraints_eq}
        ]

        print("Solving AC-OPF...")

        # Solve using SLSQP
        result = minimize(
            self.objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={
                'ftol': 1e-6,
                'maxiter': 1000,
                'disp': True
            }
        )

        print(f"\nOptimization status: {result.message}")
        print(f"Success: {result.success}")
        print(f"Iterations: {result.nit}")
        print(f"Objective value: ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")

        # Extract solution
        va_opt, vm_opt, pg_opt, qg_opt = self.unpack_x(result.x)

        # Store solution
        self.va_opt = va_opt
        self.vm_opt = vm_opt
        self.pg_opt = pg_opt
        self.qg_opt = qg_opt
        self.solver_status = "optimal" if result.success else "failed"
        self.total_cost = result.fun

        return result.success

    def calculate_branch_flows(self):
        """Calculate branch power flows"""
        V = self.vm_opt * np.exp(1j * self.va_opt)

        branch_flows = []

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if self.br_status[k] == 0:
                continue

            i = self.bus_idx[self.f_bus[k]]
            j = self.bus_idx[self.t_bus[k]]

            # Series admittance
            y_series = 1 / (self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k])
            y_shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Transformer ratio
            tap = self.tap[k] * np.exp(1j * self.shift[k])

            # Power flow from i to j
            S_ij = V[i] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[i] / tap - y_series * V[j]) / np.conj(tap)

            # Power flow from j to i
            S_ji = V[j] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[j] - y_series * V[i] / tap)

            # MVA flows
            mva_ij = abs(S_ij) * self.baseMVA
            mva_ji = abs(S_ji) * self.baseMVA

            # Loading percentage
            limit_mva = self.rate_a[k] * self.baseMVA
            if limit_mva > 0:
                loading_pct = max(mva_ij, mva_ji) / limit_mva * 100
            else:
                loading_pct = 0

            branch_flows.append({
                'from_bus': int(self.f_bus[k]),
                'to_bus': int(self.t_bus[k]),
                'loading_pct': loading_pct,
                'flow_from_MVA': mva_ij,
                'flow_to_MVA': mva_ji,
                'limit_MVA': limit_mva
            })

        # Sort by loading and return top ones
        branch_flows.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)

        return branch_flows

    def generate_report(self, output_file='report.json'):
        """Generate report in required JSON format"""
        print("\nGenerating report...")

        # Calculate totals
        total_load_MW = np.sum(self.pd) * self.baseMVA
        total_load_MVAr = np.sum(self.qd) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MW = np.sum(self.pg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MVAr = np.sum(self.qg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

        # Check feasibility
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(
            self.va_opt, self.vm_opt, self.pg_opt, self.qg_opt
        )

        max_p_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(p_residual)) * self.baseMVA
        max_q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(q_residual)) * self.baseMVA

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(self.vmin - self.vm_opt, 0) + np.maximum(self.vm_opt - self.vmax, 0)
        max_v_violation = np.max(v_violations)

        # Branch flows
        branch_flows = self.calculate_branch_flows()

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = 0
        for bf in branch_flows:
            if bf['limit_MVA'] > 0:
                overload = max(bf['flow_from_MVA'], bf['flow_to_MVA']) - bf['limit_MVA']
                max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

        # Build report
        report = {
            'summary': {
                'total_cost_per_hour': round(self.total_cost, 2),
                'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
                'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
                'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),
                'total_generation_MVAr': round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
                'total_losses_MW': round(total_losses_MW, 2),
                'solver_status': self.solver_status
            },
            'generators': [],
            'buses': [],
            'most_loaded_branches': branch_flows[:10],  # Top 10
            'feasibility_check': {
                'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_v_violation, 6),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_overload, 2)
            }
        }

        # Add generator data
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            report['generators'].append({
                'id': g + 1,
                'bus': int(self.gen_bus[g]),
                'pg_MW': round(self.pg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(self.qg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(self.pmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmax_MW': round(self.pmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(self.qmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(self.qmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2)
            })

        # Add bus data
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            report['buses'].append({
                'id': int(self.bus_id[i]),
                'vm_pu': round(self.vm_opt[i], 4),
                'va_deg': round(self.va_opt[i] * 180 / np.pi, 2),
                'vmin_pu': round(self.vmin[i], 2),
                'vmax_pu': round(self.vmax[i], 2)
            })

        # Round branch flow values
        for bf in report['most_loaded_branches']:
            bf['loading_pct'] = round(bf['loading_pct'], 2)
            bf['flow_from_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_from_MVA'], 2)
            bf['flow_to_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_to_MVA'], 2)
            bf['limit_MVA'] = round(bf['limit_MVA'], 2)

        # Write report
        with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

        print(f"Report written to {output_file}")

        # Print summary
        print("\n" + "="*60)
        print("AC-OPF SOLUTION SUMMARY")
        print("="*60)
        print(f"Total Cost:           ${self.total_cost:,.2f}/hour")
        print(f"Total Generation:     {total_gen_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Load:           {total_load_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Losses:         {total_losses_MW:,.2f} MW ({total_losses_MW/total_gen_MW*100:.2f}%)")
        print(f"Reactive Generation:  {total_gen_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print(f"Reactive Load:        {total_load_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print("\nFeasibility Check:")
        print(f"  Max P mismatch:     {max_p_mismatch:.6f} MW")
        print(f"  Max Q mismatch:     {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
        print(f"  Max V violation:    {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
        print(f"  Max overload:       {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
        print("\nMost Loaded Branches:")
        for i, bf in enumerate(branch_flows[:5], 1):
            print(f"  {i}. Bus {bf['from_bus']:3d} -> {bf['to_bus']:3d}: {bf['loading_pct']:5.1f}% ({bf['flow_from_MVA']:.1f} MVA)")
        print("="*60)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Solve AC-OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')

    success = solver.solve()

    if success:
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')
    else:
        print("\nWarning: Solver did not converge to optimal solution")
        print("Generating report with best available solution...")
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver for Independent System Operator
Solves the AC-OPF problem to find least-cost, AC-feasible operating point
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import sys

class ACOPFSolver:
    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Load and parse network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.baseMVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network()

    def parse_network(self):
        """Parse network data into structured arrays"""
        # Parse buses
        bus_data = np.array(self.data['bus'])
        self.bus_id = bus_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.bus_type = bus_data[:, 1].astype(int)
        self.pd = bus_data[:, 2] / self.baseMVA  # Convert to pu
        self.qd = bus_data[:, 3] / self.baseMVA
        self.gs = bus_data[:, 4]
        self.bs = bus_data[:, 5]
        self.vm_init = bus_data[:, 7]
        self.va_init = bus_data[:, 8] * np.pi / 180  # Convert to radians
        self.vmin = bus_data[:, 12]
        self.vmax = bus_data[:, 11]
        self.nbus = len(self.bus_id)

        # Create bus index mapping
        self.bus_idx = {int(bus_id): i for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_id)}

        # Parse generators
        gen_data = np.array(self.data['gen'])
        self.gen_bus = gen_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.gen_status = gen_data[:, 7].astype(int)
        self.pmax = gen_data[:, 8] / self.baseMVA
        self.pmin = gen_data[:, 9] / self.baseMVA
        self.qmax = gen_data[:, 3] / self.baseMVA
        self.qmin = gen_data[:, 4] / self.baseMVA
        self.vg = gen_data[:, 5]
        self.ngen = len(self.gen_bus)

        # Parse generator costs
        gencost_data = np.array(self.data['gencost'])
        self.cost_model = gencost_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.ncost = gencost_data[:, 3].astype(int)

        # Extract quadratic cost coefficients (c2, c1, c0)
        self.cost_c2 = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        self.cost_c1 = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        self.cost_c0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        for i in range(self.ngen):
            if self.cost_model[i] == 2:  # Polynomial
                n = int(self.ncost[i])
                coeffs = gencost_data[i, 4:4+n]
                if n >= 3:
                    self.cost_c2[i] = coeffs[0] * self.baseMVA**2  # Convert to $/h per pu^2
                    self.cost_c1[i] = coeffs[1] * self.baseMVA
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[2]
                elif n == 2:
                    self.cost_c1[i] = coeffs[0] * self.baseMVA
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[1]
                elif n == 1:
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[0]

        # Create generator-to-bus mapping
        self.gen_at_bus = [[] for _ in range(self.nbus)]
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bus_idx = self.bus_idx[self.gen_bus[g]]
                self.gen_at_bus[bus_idx].append(g)

        # Parse branches
        branch_data = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.f_bus = branch_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.t_bus = branch_data[:, 1].astype(int)
        self.br_r = branch_data[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branch_data[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branch_data[:, 4]
        self.rate_a = branch_data[:, 5] / self.baseMVA
        self.tap = branch_data[:, 8]
        self.shift = branch_data[:, 9] * np.pi / 180
        self.br_status = branch_data[:, 10].astype(int)
        self.angmin = branch_data[:, 11] * np.pi / 180
        self.angmax = branch_data[:, 12] * np.pi / 180
        self.nbranch = len(self.f_bus)

        # Set default tap ratio to 1 if 0
        self.tap[self.tap == 0] = 1.0

        # Build admittance matrix
        self.build_ybus()

        # Find reference bus
        self.ref_bus = np.where(self.bus_type == 3)[0]
        if len(self.ref_bus) == 0:
            print("Warning: No reference bus found, using bus 0")
            self.ref_bus = [0]
        self.ref_bus = self.ref_bus[0]

    def build_ybus(self):
        """Build bus admittance matrix"""
        self.Ybus = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if self.br_status[k] == 0:
                continue

            i = self.bus_idx[self.f_bus[k]]
            j = self.bus_idx[self.t_bus[k]]

            # Series admittance
            y_series = 1 / (self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k])

            # Shunt admittance
            y_shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Transformer ratio
            tap = self.tap[k] * np.exp(1j * self.shift[k])

            # Build Ybus
            self.Ybus[i, i] += (y_series + y_shunt) / (tap * np.conj(tap))
            self.Ybus[j, j] += y_series + y_shunt
            self.Ybus[i, j] += -y_series / np.conj(tap)
            self.Ybus[j, i] += -y_series / tap

        # Add shunt admittances
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            self.Ybus[i, i] += self.gs[i] + 1j * self.bs[i]

    def unpack_x(self, x):
        """Unpack optimization variables"""
        # x = [va[1:nbus], vm[1:nbus], pg[0:ngen], qg[0:ngen]]
        idx = 0

        va = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        va[0] = 0  # Reference angle
        va[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        vm = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        vm[0] = self.vm_init[self.ref_bus]
        vm[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        pg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]
        idx += self.ngen

        qg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]

        return va, vm, pg, qg

    def pack_x(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Pack optimization variables"""
        return np.concatenate([va[1:], vm[1:], pg, qg])

    def objective(self, x):
        """Objective function: total generation cost"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)

        # Convert pg from pu to MW for cost calculation
        pg_mw = pg * self.baseMVA

        cost = 0
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                cost += self.cost_c2[g] * pg_mw[g]**2 + self.cost_c1[g] * pg_mw[g] + self.cost_c0[g]

        return cost

    def power_balance_residuals(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Calculate power balance residuals at each bus"""
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)

        # Calculate injected power
        S_calc = V * np.conj(self.Ybus @ V)

        # Calculate net injection
        p_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for i in range(self.nbus):
            # Generation at bus
            p_gen = sum(pg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])
            q_gen = sum(qg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])

            # Net injection = generation - load
            p_net[i] = p_gen - self.pd[i]
            q_net[i] = q_gen - self.qd[i]

        # Power balance residuals
        p_residual = p_net - S_calc.real
        q_residual = q_net - S_calc.imag

        return p_residual, q_residual

    def constraints_eq(self, x):
        """Equality constraints: power balance"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(va, vm, pg, qg)

        # Stack all equality constraints
        return np.concatenate([p_residual, q_residual])

    def solve(self):
        """Solve AC-OPF using sequential quadratic programming"""
        print("Setting up AC-OPF problem...")
        print(f"Network: {self.nbus} buses, {self.ngen} generators, {self.nbranch} branches")

        # Initial point
        va0 = self.va_init.copy()
        va0[self.ref_bus] = 0

        vm0 = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Initialize pg at midpoint
        pg0 = (self.pmin + self.pmax) / 2
        pg0[self.gen_status == 0] = 0

        # Initialize qg at zero
        qg0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        x0 = self.pack_x(va0, vm0, pg0, qg0)

        # Variable bounds
        bounds = []

        # Voltage angle bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

        # Voltage magnitude bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i]))

        # Active power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Reactive power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.qmin[g], self.qmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Equality constraints
        constraints = [
            {'type': 'eq', 'fun': self.constraints_eq}
        ]

        print("Solving AC-OPF...")

        # Solve using SLSQP
        result = minimize(
            self.objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={
                'ftol': 1e-6,
                'maxiter': 1000,
                'disp': True
            }
        )

        print(f"\nOptimization status: {result.message}")
        print(f"Success: {result.success}")
        print(f"Iterations: {result.nit}")
        print(f"Objective value: ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")

        # Extract solution
        va_opt, vm_opt, pg_opt, qg_opt = self.unpack_x(result.x)

        # Store solution
        self.va_opt = va_opt
        self.vm_opt = vm_opt
        self.pg_opt = pg_opt
        self.qg_opt = qg_opt
        self.solver_status = "optimal" if result.success else "failed"
        self.total_cost = result.fun

        return result.success

    def calculate_branch_flows(self):
        """Calculate branch power flows"""
        V = self.vm_opt * np.exp(1j * self.va_opt)

        branch_flows = []

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if self.br_status[k] == 0:
                continue

            i = self.bus_idx[self.f_bus[k]]
            j = self.bus_idx[self.t_bus[k]]

            # Series admittance
            y_series = 1 / (self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k])
            y_shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Transformer ratio
            tap = self.tap[k] * np.exp(1j * self.shift[k])

            # Power flow from i to j
            S_ij = V[i] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[i] / tap - y_series * V[j]) / np.conj(tap)

            # Power flow from j to i
            S_ji = V[j] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[j] - y_series * V[i] / tap)

            # MVA flows
            mva_ij = abs(S_ij) * self.baseMVA
            mva_ji = abs(S_ji) * self.baseMVA

            # Loading percentage
            limit_mva = self.rate_a[k] * self.baseMVA
            if limit_mva > 0:
                loading_pct = max(mva_ij, mva_ji) / limit_mva * 100
            else:
                loading_pct = 0

            branch_flows.append({
                'from_bus': int(self.f_bus[k]),
                'to_bus': int(self.t_bus[k]),
                'loading_pct': loading_pct,
                'flow_from_MVA': mva_ij,
                'flow_to_MVA': mva_ji,
                'limit_MVA': limit_mva
            })

        # Sort by loading and return top ones
        branch_flows.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)

        return branch_flows

    def generate_report(self, output_file='report.json'):
        """Generate report in required JSON format"""
        print("\nGenerating report...")

        # Calculate totals
        total_load_MW = np.sum(self.pd) * self.baseMVA
        total_load_MVAr = np.sum(self.qd) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MW = np.sum(self.pg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MVAr = np.sum(self.qg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

        # Check feasibility
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(
            self.va_opt, self.vm_opt, self.pg_opt, self.qg_opt
        )

        max_p_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(p_residual)) * self.baseMVA
        max_q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(q_residual)) * self.baseMVA

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(self.vmin - self.vm_opt, 0) + np.maximum(self.vm_opt - self.vmax, 0)
        max_v_violation = np.max(v_violations)

        # Branch flows
        branch_flows = self.calculate_branch_flows()

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = 0
        for bf in branch_flows:
            if bf['limit_MVA'] > 0:
                overload = max(bf['flow_from_MVA'], bf['flow_to_MVA']) - bf['limit_MVA']
                max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

        # Build report
        report = {
            'summary': {
                'total_cost_per_hour': round(self.total_cost, 2),
                'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
                'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
                'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),
                'total_generation_MVAr': round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
                'total_losses_MW': round(total_losses_MW, 2),
                'solver_status': self.solver_status
            },
            'generators': [],
            'buses': [],
            'most_loaded_branches': branch_flows[:10],  # Top 10
            'feasibility_check': {
                'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_v_violation, 6),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_overload, 2)
            }
        }

        # Add generator data
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            report['generators'].append({
                'id': g + 1,
                'bus': int(self.gen_bus[g]),
                'pg_MW': round(self.pg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(self.qg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(self.pmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmax_MW': round(self.pmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(self.qmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(self.qmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2)
            })

        # Add bus data
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            report['buses'].append({
                'id': int(self.bus_id[i]),
                'vm_pu': round(self.vm_opt[i], 4),
                'va_deg': round(self.va_opt[i] * 180 / np.pi, 2),
                'vmin_pu': round(self.vmin[i], 2),
                'vmax_pu': round(self.vmax[i], 2)
            })

        # Round branch flow values
        for bf in report['most_loaded_branches']:
            bf['loading_pct'] = round(bf['loading_pct'], 2)
            bf['flow_from_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_from_MVA'], 2)
            bf['flow_to_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_to_MVA'], 2)
            bf['limit_MVA'] = round(bf['limit_MVA'], 2)

        # Write report
        with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

        print(f"Report written to {output_file}")

        # Print summary
        print("\n" + "="*60)
        print("AC-OPF SOLUTION SUMMARY")
        print("="*60)
        print(f"Total Cost:           ${self.total_cost:,.2f}/hour")
        print(f"Total Generation:     {total_gen_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Load:           {total_load_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Losses:         {total_losses_MW:,.2f} MW ({total_losses_MW/total_gen_MW*100:.2f}%)")
        print(f"Reactive Generation:  {total_gen_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print(f"Reactive Load:        {total_load_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print("\nFeasibility Check:")
        print(f"  Max P mismatch:     {max_p_mismatch:.6f} MW")
        print(f"  Max Q mismatch:     {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
        print(f"  Max V violation:    {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
        print(f"  Max overload:       {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
        print("\nMost Loaded Branches:")
        for i, bf in enumerate(branch_flows[:5], 1):
            print(f"  {i}. Bus {bf['from_bus']:3d} -> {bf['to_bus']:3d}: {bf['loading_pct']:5.1f}% ({bf['flow_from_MVA']:.1f} MVA)")
        print("="*60)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Solve AC-OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')

    success = solver.solve()

    if success:
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')
    else:
        print("\nWarning: Solver did not converge to optimal solution")
        print("Generating report with best available solution...")
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')
        sys.exit(1)

AC Optimal Power Flow Solver for Independent System Operator
Solves the AC-OPF problem to find least-cost, AC-feasible operating point
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import sys

class ACOPFSolver:
    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Load and parse network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.baseMVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network()

    def parse_network(self):

        bus_data = np.array(self.data['bus'])

        self.bus_type = bus_data[:, 1].astype(int)

        self.gs = bus_data[:, 4]
        self.bs = bus_data[:, 5]
        self.vm_init = bus_data[:, 7]
        self.va_init = bus_data[:, 8] * np.pi / 180  # Convert to radians
        self.vmin = bus_data[:, 12]
        self.vmax = bus_data[:, 11]
        self.nbus = len(self.bus_id)

        # Create bus index mapping
        self.bus_idx = {int(bus_id): i for i, bus_id in enumerate(self.bus_id)}

        # Parse generators
        gen_data = np.array(self.data['gen'])
        self.gen_bus = gen_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.gen_status = gen_data[:, 7].astype(int)
        self.pmax = gen_data[:, 8] / self.baseMVA
        self.pmin = gen_data[:, 9] / self.baseMVA
        self.qmax = gen_data[:, 3] / self.baseMVA
        self.qmin = gen_data[:, 4] / self.baseMVA
        self.vg = gen_data[:, 5]
        self.ngen = len(self.gen_bus)

        # Parse generator costs
        gencost_data = np.array(self.data['gencost'])
        self.cost_model = gencost_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.ncost = gencost_data[:, 3].astype(int)

        # Extract quadratic cost coefficients (c2, c1, c0)
        self.cost_c2 = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        self.cost_c1 = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        self.cost_c0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        for i in range(self.ngen):
            if self.cost_model[i] == 2:  # Polynomial
                n = int(self.ncost[i])
                coeffs = gencost_data[i, 4:4+n]
                if n >= 3:
                    self.cost_c2[i] = coeffs[0] * self.baseMVA**2  # Convert to $/h per pu^2
                    self.cost_c1[i] = coeffs[1] * self.baseMVA
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[2]
                elif n == 2:
                    self.cost_c1[i] = coeffs[0] * self.baseMVA
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[1]
                elif n == 1:
                    self.cost_c0[i] = coeffs[0]

        # Create generator-to-bus mapping
        self.gen_at_bus = [[] for _ in range(self.nbus)]
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bus_idx = self.bus_idx[self.gen_bus[g]]
                self.gen_at_bus[bus_idx].append(g)

        # Parse branches
        branch_data = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.f_bus = branch_data[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.t_bus = branch_data[:, 1].astype(int)
        self.br_r = branch_data[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branch_data[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branch_data[:, 4]
        self.rate_a = branch_data[:, 5] / self.baseMVA
        self.tap = branch_data[:, 8]
        self.shift = branch_data[:, 9] * np.pi / 180
        self.br_status = branch_data[:, 10].astype(int)
        self.angmin = branch_data[:, 11] * np.pi / 180
        self.angmax = branch_data[:, 12] * np.pi / 180
        self.nbranch = len(self.f_bus)

        # Set default tap ratio to 1 if 0
        self.tap[self.tap == 0] = 1.0

        # Build admittance matrix
        self.build_ybus()

        # Find reference bus
        self.ref_bus = np.where(self.bus_type == 3)[0]
        if len(self.ref_bus) == 0:
            print("Warning: No reference bus found, using bus 0")
            self.ref_bus = [0]
        self.ref_bus = self.ref_bus[0]

    def build_ybus(self):
        """Build bus admittance matrix"""
        self.Ybus = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if self.br_status[k] == 0:
                continue

            i = self.bus_idx[self.f_bus[k]]
            j = self.bus_idx[self.t_bus[k]]

            # Series admittance
            y_series = 1 / (self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k])

            # Shunt admittance
            y_shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Transformer ratio
            tap = self.tap[k] * np.exp(1j * self.shift[k])

            # Build Ybus
            self.Ybus[i, i] += (y_series + y_shunt) / (tap * np.conj(tap))
            self.Ybus[j, j] += y_series + y_shunt
            self.Ybus[i, j] += -y_series / np.conj(tap)
            self.Ybus[j, i] += -y_series / tap

        # Add shunt admittances
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            self.Ybus[i, i] += self.gs[i] + 1j * self.bs[i]

    def unpack_x(self, x):
        """Unpack optimization variables"""
        # x = [va[1:nbus], vm[1:nbus], pg[0:ngen], qg[0:ngen]]
        idx = 0

        va = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        va[0] = 0  # Reference angle
        va[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        vm = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        vm[0] = self.vm_init[self.ref_bus]
        vm[1:] = x[idx:idx+self.nbus-1]
        idx += self.nbus - 1

        pg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]
        idx += self.ngen

        qg = x[idx:idx+self.ngen]

        return va, vm, pg, qg

    def pack_x(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Pack optimization variables"""
        return np.concatenate([va[1:], vm[1:], pg, qg])

    def objective(self, x):
        """Objective function: total generation cost"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)

        # Convert pg from pu to MW for cost calculation
        pg_mw = pg * self.baseMVA

        cost = 0
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                cost += self.cost_c2[g] * pg_mw[g]**2 + self.cost_c1[g] * pg_mw[g] + self.cost_c0[g]

        return cost

    def power_balance_residuals(self, va, vm, pg, qg):
        """Calculate power balance residuals at each bus"""
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)

        # Calculate injected power
        S_calc = V * np.conj(self.Ybus @ V)

        # Calculate net injection
        p_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_net = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for i in range(self.nbus):
            # Generation at bus
            p_gen = sum(pg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])
            q_gen = sum(qg[g] for g in self.gen_at_bus[i])

            # Net injection = generation - load
            p_net[i] = p_gen - self.pd[i]
            q_net[i] = q_gen - self.qd[i]

        # Power balance residuals
        p_residual = p_net - S_calc.real
        q_residual = q_net - S_calc.imag

        return p_residual, q_residual

    def constraints_eq(self, x):
        """Equality constraints: power balance"""
        va, vm, pg, qg = self.unpack_x(x)
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(va, vm, pg, qg)

        # Stack all equality constraints
        return np.concatenate([p_residual, q_residual])

    def solve(self):
        """Solve AC-OPF using sequential quadratic programming"""
        print("Setting up AC-OPF problem...")
        print(f"Network: {self.nbus} buses, {self.ngen} generators, {self.nbranch} branches")

        # Calculate total load
        total_load_p = np.sum(self.pd)
        total_load_q = np.sum(self.qd)

        print(f"Total P load: {total_load_p * self.baseMVA:.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Q load: {total_load_q * self.baseMVA:.2f} MVAr")

        # Initial point
        va0 = self.va_init.copy()
        va0[self.ref_bus] = 0

        vm0 = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Initialize pg proportional to capacity, meeting total load
        total_capacity = np.sum(self.pmax[self.gen_status == 1])
        pg0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        # Estimate losses as 2% of load
        estimated_generation = total_load_p * 1.02

        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                # Proportional to capacity
                pg0[g] = (self.pmax[g] / total_capacity) * estimated_generation
                # Clip to bounds
                pg0[g] = np.clip(pg0[g], self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g])

        # Initialize qg proportional to reactive demand
        qg0 = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        ngen_active = np.sum(self.gen_status == 1)
        if ngen_active > 0:
            qg0[self.gen_status == 1] = total_load_q / ngen_active
            for g in range(self.ngen):
                qg0[g] = np.clip(qg0[g], self.qmin[g], self.qmax[g])

        x0 = self.pack_x(va0, vm0, pg0, qg0)

        # Variable bounds
        bounds = []

        # Voltage angle bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

        # Voltage magnitude bounds (skip reference bus)
        for i in range(1, self.nbus):
            bounds.append((self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i]))

        # Active power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Reactive power bounds
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[g] == 1:
                bounds.append((self.qmin[g], self.qmax[g]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Equality constraints
        constraints = [
            {'type': 'eq', 'fun': self.constraints_eq}
        ]

        print("Solving AC-OPF...")

        # Solve using SLSQP
        result = minimize(
            self.objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={
                'ftol': 1e-6,
                'maxiter': 1000,
                'disp': True
            }
        )

        print(f"\nOptimization status: {result.message}")
        print(f"Success: {result.success}")
        print(f"Iterations: {result.nit}")
        print(f"Objective value: ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")

        # Extract solution
        va_opt, vm_opt, pg_opt, qg_opt = self.unpack_x(result.x)

        # Store solution
        self.va_opt = va_opt
        self.vm_opt = vm_opt
        self.pg_opt = pg_opt
        self.qg_opt = qg_opt
        self.solver_status = "optimal" if result.success else "failed"
        self.total_cost = result.fun

        return result.success

    def calculate_branch_flows(self):
        """Calculate branch power flows"""
        V = self.vm_opt * np.exp(1j * self.va_opt)

        branch_flows = []

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if self.br_status[k] == 0:
                continue

            i = self.bus_idx[self.f_bus[k]]
            j = self.bus_idx[self.t_bus[k]]

            # Series admittance
            y_series = 1 / (self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k])
            y_shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Transformer ratio
            tap = self.tap[k] * np.exp(1j * self.shift[k])

            # Power flow from i to j
            S_ij = V[i] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[i] / tap - y_series * V[j]) / np.conj(tap)

            # Power flow from j to i
            S_ji = V[j] * np.conj((y_series + y_shunt) * V[j] - y_series * V[i] / tap)

            # MVA flows
            mva_ij = abs(S_ij) * self.baseMVA
            mva_ji = abs(S_ji) * self.baseMVA

            # Loading percentage
            limit_mva = self.rate_a[k] * self.baseMVA
            if limit_mva > 0:
                loading_pct = max(mva_ij, mva_ji) / limit_mva * 100
            else:
                loading_pct = 0

            branch_flows.append({
                'from_bus': int(self.f_bus[k]),
                'to_bus': int(self.t_bus[k]),
                'loading_pct': loading_pct,
                'flow_from_MVA': mva_ij,
                'flow_to_MVA': mva_ji,
                'limit_MVA': limit_mva
            })

        # Sort by loading and return top ones
        branch_flows.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)

        return branch_flows

    def generate_report(self, output_file='report.json'):
        """Generate report in required JSON format"""
        print("\nGenerating report...")

        # Calculate totals
        total_load_MW = np.sum(self.pd) * self.baseMVA
        total_load_MVAr = np.sum(self.qd) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MW = np.sum(self.pg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_gen_MVAr = np.sum(self.qg_opt[self.gen_status == 1]) * self.baseMVA
        total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

        # Check feasibility
        p_residual, q_residual = self.power_balance_residuals(
            self.va_opt, self.vm_opt, self.pg_opt, self.qg_opt
        )

        max_p_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(p_residual)) * self.baseMVA
        max_q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(q_residual)) * self.baseMVA

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(self.vmin - self.vm_opt, 0) + np.maximum(self.vm_opt - self.vmax, 0)
        max_v_violation = np.max(v_violations)

        # Branch flows
        branch_flows = self.calculate_branch_flows()

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = 0
        for bf in branch_flows:
            if bf['limit_MVA'] > 0:
                overload = max(bf['flow_from_MVA'], bf['flow_to_MVA']) - bf['limit_MVA']
                max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

        # Build report
        report = {
            'summary': {
                'total_cost_per_hour': round(self.total_cost, 2),
                'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
                'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
                'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),
                'total_generation_MVAr': round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
                'total_losses_MW': round(total_losses_MW, 2),
                'solver_status': self.solver_status
            },
            'generators': [],
            'buses': [],
            'most_loaded_branches': branch_flows[:10],  # Top 10
            'feasibility_check': {
                'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_v_violation, 6),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_overload, 2)
            }
        }

        # Add generator data
        for g in range(self.ngen):
            report['generators'].append({
                'id': g + 1,
                'bus': int(self.gen_bus[g]),
                'pg_MW': round(self.pg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(self.qg_opt[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(self.pmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'pmax_MW': round(self.pmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(self.qmin[g] * self.baseMVA, 2),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(self.qmax[g] * self.baseMVA, 2)
            })

        # Add bus data
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            report['buses'].append({
                'id': int(self.bus_id[i]),
                'vm_pu': round(self.vm_opt[i], 4),
                'va_deg': round(self.va_opt[i] * 180 / np.pi, 2),
                'vmin_pu': round(self.vmin[i], 2),
                'vmax_pu': round(self.vmax[i], 2)
            })

        # Round branch flow values
        for bf in report['most_loaded_branches']:
            bf['loading_pct'] = round(bf['loading_pct'], 2)
            bf['flow_from_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_from_MVA'], 2)
            bf['flow_to_MVA'] = round(bf['flow_to_MVA'], 2)
            bf['limit_MVA'] = round(bf['limit_MVA'], 2)

        # Write report
        with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

        print(f"Report written to {output_file}")

        # Print summary
        print("\n" + "="*60)
        print("AC-OPF SOLUTION SUMMARY")
        print("="*60)
        print(f"Total Cost:           ${self.total_cost:,.2f}/hour")
        print(f"Total Generation:     {total_gen_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Load:           {total_load_MW:,.2f} MW")
        print(f"Total Losses:         {total_losses_MW:,.2f} MW ({total_losses_MW/total_gen_MW*100:.2f}%)")
        print(f"Reactive Generation:  {total_gen_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print(f"Reactive Load:        {total_load_MVAr:,.2f} MVAr")
        print("\nFeasibility Check:")
        print(f"  Max P mismatch:     {max_p_mismatch:.6f} MW")
        print(f"  Max Q mismatch:     {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
        print(f"  Max V violation:    {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
        print(f"  Max overload:       {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
        print("\nMost Loaded Branches:")
        for i, bf in enumerate(branch_flows[:5], 1):
            print(f"  {i}. Bus {bf['from_bus']:3d} -> {bf['to_bus']:3d}: {bf['loading_pct']:5.1f}% ({bf['flow_from_MVA']:.1f} MVA)")
        print("="*60)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Solve AC-OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')

    success = solver.solve()

    if success:
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')
    else:
        print("\nWarning: Solver did not converge to optimal solution")
        print("Generating report with best available solution...")
        solver.generate_report('/root/report.json')
        sys.exit(1)
